gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diffuse Midline Glioma, H3 K27M-Mutant; Recurrent High Grade Glioma
Histologically confirmed newly diagnosed DIPG/DMG with documented H3K27M alteration (based on IHC or DNA sequencing performed in a CLIA-certified laboratory) or recurrent HGG.

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a single center Phase I study of a new adjuvant CD200 activation receptor ligand, CD200AR-L, in combination with imiquimod and GBM6-AD vaccine to treat malignant glioma in children and young adults.
CD200AR-L is a newly developed agent that binds to CD200-AR.

candidate_flag.reason: CD200AR-L is described as a vaccine adjuvant; it could be judged part of the excluded vaccine intervention rather than a pharmacological candidate.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Study treatment will begin approximately 14 days after the completion of standard of care radiation therapy for patients with newly diagnosed DMG/DIPG and at the time of recurrence for patients with HGG.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Willing to allow for collection of pre-treatment research related blood collection

role_evidence.quote: To determine the maximum tolerated dose and side-effects of the experimental medicine, CD200AR-L, when given with a fixed dose of GBM6-AD vaccine in combination with imiquimod cream and a single dose of radiation on Day 15

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational CD200 activation receptor ligand (peptide immunomodulator / vaccine adjuvant)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: administering agents that bind to the CD200 activation receptor (CD200-AR) on immune cells results in activation of immune cells and overcomes any inhibitory signals caused by CD200

flag.reason: Described as a vaccine adjuvant; may be considered part of the excluded vaccine intervention.

role_evidence.quote: This will be given with fixed doses of 1mg GBM6-AD vaccine and topical imiquimod.

agents.drug_class_hint: topical TLR7 agonist, licensed for skin conditions; used as vaccine adjuvant

flag.reason: Fixed-dose vaccine adjuvant given to all patients; could alternatively be an experimental_combination partner.

role_evidence.quote: Treatment with CD200AR-L (up to 3 dose levels of CD200AR-L with a Dose Level -1 in the event of toxicity) with fixed doses of GBM6-AD vaccine.

agents.drug_class_hint: allogeneic glioma tumour lysate cancer vaccine (GBM6-AD)

source_quote.quote: Histologically confirmed newly diagnosed DIPG/DMG with documented H3K27M alteration (based on IHC or DNA sequencing performed in a CLIA-certified laboratory) or recurrent HGG.

coder_notes: Paediatric/young adult (2-25 y; mixed_age). Population recurrent HGG and H3K27M DMG/DIPG; glioblastoma not named in conditions, title, inclusion or arm labels ('GBM6-AD' is only the vaccine name), so high_grade_glioma_unspecified (excluded at S5). Single registered DRUG intervention bundles CD200AR-L, imiquimod, GBM6-AD vaccine and radiotherapy; listed as separate agents. CD200AR-L is the dose-escalated investigational agent (experimental_monotherapy); imiquimod coded soc_backbone as a fixed vaccine adjuvant (flagged); vaccine is excluded type. H3K27M is required for the DMG/DIPG subgroup only (coded enrichment; no separate arm). Immune characterization bloods not linked explicitly to CD200AR-L target, so target engagement unclear.
